claims.claim: The current published release of israeli-bank-scrapers on npm is 6.9.0 (2026-07-22). The package is library-only (bin is null), so there is no CLI to invoke.

Upstream israeli-bank-scrapers CompanyTypes enum contains 14 bank scrapers (hapoalim, leumi, mizrahi, discount, mercantile, otsarHahayal, beinleumi, pagi, union, yahav, massad, oneZero, behatsdaa, beyahadBishvilha) and 4 card scrapers (visaCal, max, isracard, amex). Mercantile and Otsar Hahayal are SEPARATE scrapers with their own loginFields, not subsumed under Discount/FIBI.

Bank of Israel's Access to Payment Systems section assigns banks their identification (participant) codes, currently 2-digit and being expanded to 3 digits by end of Dec 2026. The standard 2-digit clearing codes used in the table (Leumi=10, Discount=11, Hapoalim=12, Union=13, Otsar Hahayal=14, Mercantile=17, OneZero=18, Mizrahi-Tefahot=20, FIBI=31, Yahav=04, Massad=46, Pagi=52) are stable public Israeli bank codes verified against independent bank-code lists (e.g. science.co.il, ezcount). The BOI section page itself does not inline the full code list (the downloadable list sits under its payment-systems publications).
BOI English Consumer Enquiries and Inspections page (banking complaints and consumer info, verified 200 OK via WebFetch)

claims.claim: israeli-bank-scrapers 6.9.0 (2026-07-22) is the current release. It added Leumi savings accounts and Max credit card balances; 6.8.0 completed the Visa Cal frame implementation; 6.7.10 added an Isracard bot-detection workaround and 6.7.9 fixed a Max login-page failure.
claims.raw_snippet: **leumi:** add savings accounts ... **max:** add credit card balances

claims.claim: il-bank-mcp declares israeli-bank-scrapers ^6.1.4 in packages/scraper/package.json, but its committed yarn.lock resolves it to exactly 6.1.4 (published 2025-06-09). That predates v6.7.9 (max: scrape fails on login page), v6.7.10 (isracard: workaround for bot detection) and v6.8.0 (visa-cal: complete unfinished frame implementation), so Max, Isracard and Visa Cal do not work on it. Verified by cloning the repo and reading yarn.lock, and against the upstream release notes.

The Bank of Israel Consumer Enquiries and Inspections Unit handles complaints from bank and credit card customers. Used as the pointer for the terms-of-service and fraud-liability caution. The caution itself is stated qualitatively: no specific BOI directive number is asserted.
